svg.title: How an optical fibre guides light
svg.desc: A core with a higher refractive index than its cladding can guide light by total internal reflection; the external coating has a protective role. A generated text-free glass cutaway as the hero, anchored editable annotations and a separate vector inset that carries the ray geometry.

text.tspan: How an optical fibre guides light
One explanation, three visual directions. A conceptual step-index fibre in the ray model.

image.title: Magnified conceptual cutaway of a straight optical fibre with an amber core, glass cladding and teal protective coating. Colours and proportions are illustrative.

text.tspan: Total internal reflection occurs at the core–cladding boundary.
θ is measured from the normal.
The coating protects the glass; index contrast guides
Conceptual geometry, not to scale · θ is the internal incidence angle · source: OpenStax, University Physics Vol. 3, §1.4
